q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 23, 2026. The Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for August 26, 2026 — **3 days away**. This is an extremely short timeframe. The forward guidance will be announced at or immediately following the earnings release.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided official forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 (released May 20, 2026):
- **$91.0 billion ± 2%**
- This translates to a range of **$89.2 billion to $92.8 billion**

With only 3 days until the earnings announcement, this guidance is almost certainly what will be released. Companies do not typically revise forward guidance between the time they announce it and the actual earnings call, unless there has been a material change to business conditions. The research indicates:

- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion
- Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0 billion (already provided)
- Analyst consensus: $91.9 billion (within NVIDIA's guided range)
- Important qualifier: This guidance does NOT assume any Data Center compute revenue from China

## (c) What would push the value lower?

1. **Unexpected negative business development** in the next 72 hours (extremely unlikely)
2. **China-related policy changes** that significantly impact near-term demand (though current guidance already excludes China Data Center revenue)
3. **Macro shock or demand deterioration** discovered in the final days before earnings (very low probability given recent Q1 results of $81.6B were strong)

## (d) What would push the value higher?

1. **Upward revision due to stronger-than-expected demand** in final weeks of the quarter (possible but would be unusual this close to earnings)
2. **Better-than-expected performance** in non-Data-Center segments
3. **Easing of China restrictions** that NVIDIA didn't account for in their $91B guidance

However, companies typically anchor on guidance they've already provided for this exact quarter. Revising 3 days before earnings would be unusual unless conditions materially shifted.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research explicitly states NVIDIA's May 20, 2026 forward guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**

This is not a prediction or analyst estimate — it is NVIDIA's own official forward guidance already provided to the market. The question asks what will be in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26, 2026, and that guidance has already been announced. Unless something material changes in the next 72 hours (highly unlikely), this will be the number.

## Reasoning on the distribution

Given that:
- Official guidance of $91.0B ± 2% has already been provided
- This translates to $89.2B – $92.8B range
- The resolution range is $99.5B – $115.5B (much broader, with open bounds)
- We are 3 days from the announcement
- No material negative catalyst has emerged

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reiterate or slightly adjust the $91.0B guidance they already provided. The probability mass should center around $90-92B, well below the $99.5B floor shown in the resolution range. This suggests the resolution range may be illustrative of a broader possible outcome space, not the base case.

My estimate centers on the $91.0B guidance already provided, with modest uncertainty for last-minute adjustments:

Low (10th percentile): 89200000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 92800000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, predicts $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This implies a range from approximately $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Analysts' average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.9 billion, falling within NVIDIA's projected range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). For comparison, NVIDIA reported $81.6 billion in revenue for Q1 FY2027 [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for August 26, 2026 [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).
